scripts.build:web: cd web && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.deploy: bun scripts/require-build-env.ts && bun run build:web && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:preview: bun scripts/require-build-env.ts && bun run build:web && wrangler versions upload --preview-alias app
scripts.deploy:staging: bun scripts/require-build-env.ts && bun run build:web && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json
